paragraph: Hasbrouck Heights is a single-family market, and the numbers are consistent across the board: 27 sales over six months at a median of $750,000, a sale-to-list ratio of 1.02, roughly 63 percent of homes selling above asking, and a median of 19 days on market. That is a real seller's market, with plenty of multiple offer situations on the homes that show well. The typical sale is a three-bedroom colonial with two full baths, and capes and ranches fill in the rest. Sales run from $460,000 to $999,999, so the median is the number to anchor on. Monthly counts are too thin to read a price trend, though volume did build into June and July the way it usually does here. If the usual seasonal arc holds, expect closings to taper modestly through fall. Buyers should expect competition on the good ones, and you'll want your financing tight before you write an offer.
